formulas.tex: \term{horizonAngle}{h} = \arctan\max_{k}\frac{\term{rise}{\zeta (z_k - z_0) - c\,d_k^2}}{\term{groundDistance}{d_k}},\quad \term{visibility}{V} = 1 - \frac{\arccos u - u\sqrt{1 - u^2}}{\pi},\ u = \operatorname{clip}\!\left(\frac{\term{altitude}{\alpha} - h}{\term{radius}{\rho}},\,-1,\,1\right)
formulas.ascii: h = atan(max over pixel centres k on the digital line toward the sun of rise_k / d_k), rise_k = zFactor * (z_k - z_0) - c * d_k^2, in degrees; V = 1 - (acos(u) - u * sqrt(1 - u^2)) / pi with u = clamp((altitude - h) / radius, -1, 1); radius 0 gives a step; V = 0 when altitude + radius <= 0; h = 0 with no valid sample; NaN at a nodata centre
